content: Inter-annotator agreement is calculated based on two case reports. We reach a Cohen's kappa BIBREF6 of 0.68. Disagreements mainly appear for findings that are rather unspecific such as She no longer eats out with friends which can be seen as a finding referring to “avoidance behaviour”.
